el.Pinto obras abstractas en técnica mixta,: I paint abstract mixed-media works, one by one, in my studio. Choose yours, I'll help you see it on your wall, and I'll ship it anywhere in the country and abroad.
el.Te acompaño desde que elegís la obra has: I'm with you from the moment you choose the work until it's hanging on your wall.
el.Mirá las obras disponibles y escribime p: Browse the available works and write to me about the one you like. I'll send you the price and all the details.
el.Contame dónde la querés colgar y te ayud: Tell me where you'd like to hang it and I'll help you see it on your wall before you decide.
el.Si querés, vení a verla: If you like, come see it
el.Podés visitar mi showroom con cita previ: You can visit my showroom by appointment and see the works in person.
el.Coordinamos el envío a cualquier punto d: We'll arrange shipping to anywhere in the country, and abroad too.
el.Cada obra es única: Each work is one of a kind
el.Piezas originales, pintadas a mano y fir: Original pieces, hand-painted and signed. Once a work is sold, it won't be repeated. Tap “Ask for price” and I'll reply on WhatsApp.
el.Acrílicos y pastel a la tiza sobre lienz: Acrylics and chalk pastel on canvas
el.Al ser piezas únicas, la disponibilidad: Since each piece is one of a kind, availability may change, so please confirm when you write to me. There are more works in the full gallery.
el.Una serie que tuvo muchísimas obras y es: A series that included a great many works and is central to my path as an artist. A few are still available: they're ideal for starting a collection, creating a composition on a wall, or giving art as a gift.
el.Una obra no es solo una imagen: es una p: A work is not just an image: it's a presence
el.Convivís con ella todos los días y siemp: You live with it every day and always discover something new in it. That's why I'll help you choose the size and the place: write to me and I'll help you see it on your wall.
el.Si buscás una medida, una paleta o un fo: If you're looking for a specific size, palette or format, I can paint a piece to order. We'll talk about what you have in mind and what the space is like, and shape the idea together. Commissions are taken in order: write to me and I'll save your place on the list.
el.Obra a pedido · 110 cm de diámetro · Téc: Made to order · 110 cm diameter · Mixed media on canvas
el.Mi taller es mi mundo: el lugar donde na: My studio is my world: the place where the works are born. By appointment, you can come to see them, talk about each one over a coffee and choose without any rush.
el.Pinto hace más de veinte años. Empecé es: I've been painting for more than twenty years. I started out studying computer systems, but my passion was art: I took workshops with renowned artists and haven't stopped since.
el.Mi trabajo es una búsqueda constante: ex: My work is a constant search: to express my inner self through painting. Color is my language, the voice I use to speak without words. Materials don't limit me, which is why almost all my works are mixed media.
el.«Un volcán de formas y colores sugerente: “A volcano of suggestive forms and colors gives identity to her paintings.”<cite>Marino Santa María, visual artist</cite>
